- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Engineering knowledge graphs, schema.org JSON-LD microdata, and semantic entity clusters specifically for citation by LLMs including ChatGPT, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): Direct question-answering architecture structured for featured snippets, voice search, and conversational LLM retrieval.
- AI Optimization (AIO): Multi-modal data structuring and entity disambiguation for LLMs and AI search algorithms.
